connector.name: FineRx
connector.registryDescription: US Rx price comparison + foreign-brand US-equivalent lookup. Observed prices, read-only.
connector.summary: Hosted at finerxfinder.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package finerx-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.finerxfinder, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FINERX_API_KEY
env.description: FineRx developer key (frx_live_...). Request one at https://www.finerxfinder.com/developers

env.name: FINERX_API_BASE
env.description: Override the public API base URL (defaults to the production surface).
